integrity: The analytic proof supplies explicit free-face pairs and a simple-connectivity argument for all admissible integers. Standalone finite checks test examples only. No independent audit or externally certified proof is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only intrinsic graph Čech scale two for \(n,q\ge3\); no higher-scale, persistence-map, or equivariant claim; the finite \((n,q)=(3,3)\) instance was previously obtained and is not claimed as new. An unindexed equivalent broader classification remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Scale-two Čech complexes of multinary Hamming graphs collapse to wedges of two-spheres
